datasets.name: a5510c39
queryLines:
select
  case
    when dashboard_name rlike '.* [0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} .*' then 'unnamed_dashboard'
    else dashboard_name
  end as dashboard_name,
  sum(num_views) as num_views

datasets.name: 9d2c306d
queryLines:
WITH weekly_views AS (
  SELECT
    dashboard_id,
    workspace_id,
    first(dashboard_name) as dashboard_name,
    weekofyear(viewed_date) AS week_num,
    sum(num_views) AS num_views
  FROM mvFactDashboardUsage
  WHERE viewed_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 21 DAYS
  GROUP BY dashboard_id, workspace_id, weekofyear(viewed_date)
),
weekly_ranks AS (
  SELECT
    dashboard_id,
    workspace_id,
    dashboard_name,
    week_num,
    num_views,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY week_num ORDER BY num_views DESC) AS week_rank
  FROM weekly_views
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    dashboard_id,
    workspace_id,
    first(dashboard_name) as dashboard_name,
    coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN week_num = weekofyear(current_date()) THEN num_views END), 0) AS week_0_views,
    coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN week_num = weekofyear(current_date() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS) THEN num_views END), 0 ) AS week_1_views,
    coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN week_num = weekofyear(current_date() - INTERVAL 14 DAYS) THEN num_views END), 0 ) AS week_2_views,
    coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN week_num = weekofyear(current_date()) THEN week_rank END), 999) AS week_0_rank,
    coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN week_num = weekofyear(current_date() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS) THEN week_rank END), 999) AS week_1_rank,
    coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN week_num = weekofyear(current_date() - INTERVAL 14 DAYS) THEN week_rank END), 999) AS week_2_rank,
    SUM(num_views) AS total_views
  FROM weekly_ranks
  GROUP BY dashboard_id,workspace_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    dashboard_id,
    workspace_id,
    dashboard_name,
    week_0_views,
    week_1_views,
    week_2_views,
    week_0_rank,
    week_1_rank,
    week_2_rank,
    total_views,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_views DESC) AS overall_rank
  FROM pivoted
)
SELECT
  overall_rank,
  r.dashboard_name,
  dashboard_id,
  workspace_id,
  coalesce(week_0_views,week_1_views) AS this_week_views,
  coalesce(week_0_rank,week_1_rank) AS this_week_rank,
  week_1_views AS last_week_views,
  week_1_rank AS last_week_rank,
  week_2_views AS two_weeks_ago_views,
  week_2_rank AS two_weeks_ago_rank,
  this_week_rank - last_week_rank AS rank_change
FROM ranked r
WHERE overall_rank <= 10 and week_0_rank < 999
ORDER BY overall_rank
--

datasets.name: f8608a63
queryLines:
WITH monthly_views AS (
  SELECT
    dashboard_id,
    any_value(dashboard_name) as dashboard_name,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', viewed_date) AS month,
    SUM(num_views) AS total_views
  FROM mvFactDashboardUsage
  WHERE viewed_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' MONTH
  GROUP BY dashboard_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', viewed_date)
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    dashboard_name,
    MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) THEN total_views END) AS this_month_views,
    MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' MONTH THEN total_views END) AS last_month_views
  FROM monthly_views
  GROUP BY dashboard_name
),
diffs AS (
  SELECT
    dashboard_name,
    COALESCE(this_month_views, 0) - COALESCE(last_month_views, 0) AS view_diff
  FROM pivoted
),
climbers AS (
  SELECT
    dashboard_name,
    view_diff,
    'Climber' AS type,
    1 AS sort_order,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY view_diff DESC) AS rank
  FROM diffs
  ORDER BY view_diff DESC
  LIMIT 20
),
decliners AS (
  SELECT
    dashboard_name,
    view_diff,
    'Decliner' AS type,
    2 AS sort_order,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY view_diff ASC) AS rank
  FROM diffs
  ORDER BY view_diff ASC
  LIMIT 20
)
SELECT dashboard_name, view_diff, type, rank
FROM (
  (SELECT dashboard_name, view_diff, type, sort_order, rank FROM climbers)
  UNION ALL
  (SELECT dashboard_name, view_diff, type, sort_order, rank FROM decliners)
)
ORDER BY sort_order, rank

datasets.name: ov_kpi
queryLines:
WITH msg AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) questions, COUNT(DISTINCT user_email) users, COUNT(DISTINCT space_id) active_spaces
  FROM adb_genie_messages
  WHERE created_timestamp >= :param.min AND created_timestamp <= :param.max AND (:space_id = 'ALL' OR space_id = :space_id)
),
wh AS (
  SELECT SUM(query_attributed_dollars_estimation) usd FROM dbsql_cost_per_query_table
  WHERE query_source_type='GENIE SPACE' AND start_time >= :param.min AND start_time <= :param.max AND (:space_id = 'ALL' OR query_source_id = :space_id)
),
tok AS (
  SELECT SUM(token_cost_usd) usd, SUM(token_dbus) dbus FROM mvFactGenieTokenUsage
  WHERE genie_surface='GENIE_AGENTS' AND usage_date >= :param.min AND usage_date <= :param.max AND (:space_id = 'ALL' OR agent_id = :space_id)
)
SELECT msg.active_spaces, msg.questions, msg.users, COALESCE(wh.usd,0) warehouse_usd, COALESCE(tok.usd,0) token_usd, COALESCE(tok.dbus,0) token_dbus
FROM msg, wh, tok

datasets.name: ov_leaderboard
queryLines:
WITH msg AS (
  SELECT space_id, space_name, COUNT(*) questions, COUNT(DISTINCT user_email) users
  FROM adb_genie_messages WHERE created_timestamp >= :param.min AND created_timestamp <= :param.max AND (:space_id = 'ALL' OR space_id = :space_id)
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
views AS (
  SELECT space_id, SUM(space_views) views FROM mvFactGenieUsage
  WHERE activity_date >= :param.min AND activity_date <= :param.max AND (:space_id = 'ALL' OR space_id = :space_id) GROUP BY 1
),
wh AS (
  SELECT query_source_id space_id, SUM(query_attributed_dollars_estimation) warehouse_usd FROM dbsql_cost_per_query_table
  WHERE query_source_type='GENIE SPACE' AND start_time >= :param.min AND start_time <= :param.max AND (:space_id = 'ALL' OR query_source_id = :space_id) GROUP BY 1
),
tok AS (
  SELECT agent_id space_id, SUM(token_cost_usd) token_usd FROM mvFactGenieTokenUsage
  WHERE genie_surface='GENIE_AGENTS' AND usage_date >= :param.min AND usage_date <= :param.max AND (:space_id = 'ALL' OR agent_id = :space_id) GROUP BY 1
),
fb AS (
  SELECT space_id, COUNT_IF(feedback_rating='POSITIVE') pos, COUNT_IF(feedback_rating='NEGATIVE') neg
  FROM adb_genie_messages WHERE (:space_id = 'ALL' OR space_id = :space_id) GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.space_name, m.questions, m.users, COALESCE(v.views,0) views,
       COALESCE(w.warehouse_usd,0) warehouse_usd, COALESCE(t.token_usd,0) token_usd,
       COALESCE(fb.pos,0) positive, COALESCE(fb.neg,0) negative
FROM msg m
LEFT JOIN views v ON m.space_id=v.space_id
LEFT JOIN wh w ON m.space_id=w.space_id
LEFT JOIN tok t ON m.space_id=t.space_id
LEFT JOIN fb ON m.space_id=fb.space_id

datasets.name: us_kpi
queryLines:
WITH msg AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) questions, COUNT(DISTINCT user_email) users, COUNT(DISTINCT conversation_id) convs
  FROM adb_genie_messages WHERE created_timestamp >= :param.min AND created_timestamp <= :param.max AND (:space_id = 'ALL' OR space_id = :space_id)
),
mc AS (
  SELECT conversation_id, COUNT(*) c FROM adb_genie_messages
  WHERE created_timestamp >= :param.min AND created_timestamp <= :param.max AND (:space_id = 'ALL' OR space_id = :space_id) GROUP BY 1
),
views AS (
  SELECT SUM(space_views) views FROM mvFactGenieUsage
  WHERE activity_date >= :param.min AND activity_date <= :param.max AND (:space_id = 'ALL' OR space_id = :space_id)
)
SELECT msg.questions, msg.users, COALESCE(views.views,0) views,
       (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c) FROM mc) median_msgs_per_conv
FROM msg, views

queryLines:

datasets.name: co_kpi
queryLines:
WITH wh AS (SELECT SUM(query_attributed_dollars_estimation) usd, COUNT(DISTINCT statement_id) stmts FROM dbsql_cost_per_query_table WHERE query_source_type='GENIE SPACE' AND start_time>=:param.min AND start_time<=:param.max AND (:space_id = 'ALL' OR query_source_id = :space_id)),
tok AS (SELECT SUM(token_cost_usd) usd FROM mvFactGenieTokenUsage WHERE genie_surface='GENIE_AGENTS' AND usage_date>=:param.min AND usage_date<=:param.max AND (:space_id = 'ALL' OR agent_id = :space_id)),
q AS (SELECT COUNT(*) questions FROM adb_genie_messages WHERE created_timestamp>=:param.min AND created_timestamp<=:param.max AND (:space_id = 'ALL' OR space_id = :space_id))
SELECT COALESCE(wh.usd,0) warehouse_usd, COALESCE(tok.usd,0) token_usd,
       CASE WHEN q.questions>0 THEN COALESCE(wh.usd,0)/q.questions ELSE 0 END avg_wh_per_q
FROM wh, tok, q

datasets.name: co_category
queryLines:
SELECT s.name genie_space, v.genie_cost_category, v.genie_cost_class,
       SUM(v.query_attributed_dollars_estimation) cost_usd
FROM genie_cost_categorised v JOIN adb_genie_spaces s ON v.query_source_id=s.space_id
WHERE v.start_time>=:param.min AND v.start_time<=:param.max AND (:space_id = 'ALL' OR v.query_source_id = :space_id)
GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: co_perq
queryLines:
SELECT space_name, LEFT(user_question,80) question, num_statements, ROUND(message_cost_usd,5) cost_usd
FROM genie_cost_per_message_table
WHERE created_datetime>=:param.min AND created_datetime<=:param.max AND (:space_id = 'ALL' OR space_id = :space_id)
ORDER BY message_cost_usd DESC LIMIT 25

datasets.name: co_token
queryLines:
SELECT space_name, SUM(token_dbus) token_dbus, SUM(token_cost_usd) token_usd
FROM mvFactGenieTokenUsage WHERE genie_surface='GENIE_AGENTS' AND space_name IS NOT NULL
  AND usage_date>=:param.min AND usage_date<=:param.max AND (:space_id = 'ALL' OR agent_id = :space_id)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY token_dbus DESC

Genie Space — Overview
⚠️ Cost metrics (system tables) span all workspaces in this metastore; question/feedback metrics (Genie API) are limited to spaces this deployment can access. Selecting a specific space aligns both to that space's workspace.

Genie Space — Usage Analytics

Genie Space — Cost Analytics
⚠️ Cost metrics (system tables) span all workspaces in this metastore; question/feedback metrics (Genie API) are limited to spaces this deployment can access. Selecting a specific space aligns both to that space's workspace.

Warehouse cost breakdown
A space's warehouse cost = conversational (actual Genie messages) + authoring/profiling operations + overhead. These components sum exactly to the space's warehouse cost in dbsql_cost_per_query.

Genie Token Usage — Suite-wide
LLM token consumption across ALL Genie products (Code / One / Agents), in DBUs. Free-tier (GENIE_FREE_USAGE) is $0. Account-wide across the metastore.
